First non-harness project statement that materializes the parser-visible input span. After the harness consumes its two 4-byte flag words, md4c stores a pointer to the remaining Markdown slice and its length in `ctx`.

breakpoints.code:
if(off > beg  &&
       (CH(off) == _T('.') || CH(off) == _T(')'))  &&
       (off+1 >= ctx->size || ISBLANK(off+1) || ISNEWLINE(off+1)))
breakpoints.note: After ordered-list digit scanning advances `off` to the end of the document, this condition checks only `off > beg` before dereferencing `CH(off)` to look for `'.'` or `')'`. When the digit run reaches the document boundary, `off == ctx->size`, so the delimiter probe itself is out of bounds. The patch fixes this exact obligation by inserting `off < ctx->size` before `CH(off)`.
